name: Auction Forty-Fives
description: Auction Forty-Fives (45s, Nova Scotia style) is a partnership trick game: 4 or 6 players, 5 cards each plus 4-card kitty. Bid in 5s (min 15-20); high bidder declares trump and may exchange with kitty. First team to 120 wins. Trump: 5 highest, then J, then A of hearts (always trump). Each trick 5 points; highest trump in trick +5. Special: 30 for 60 (win all tricks); 60 for 120 when below zero. Part of the Forty-Fives and Spoil Five family; regional rules vary.

Descendant of the Irish game Spoil Five; widely played among Irish communities in the New World, especially in Nova Scotia and the rest of Atlantic Canada.
4 or 6 in partnerships (opposite). 5 cards each (3+2), 4-card kitty.
52 cards. Trump: 5 high, then J, A of hearts always trump.
Left of dealer bids first; dealer may hold. High bidder names trump, may exchange with kitty.

items.text: Nova Scotia 45s: Standard rules as documented; bid in 5s, 120 to win.
